description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," illustrates the proportional contribution of various data sources to a training dataset. The chart is composed of multiple colored slices, each representing a distinct source and its corresponding percentage. The largest slice, colored blue, corresponds to NQ, which accounts for 31.3% of the data. The second largest is FEVER, shown in teal, contributing 16.1%. Other notable contributors include MULTIFC (11.3%, light teal), SNLI (15.4%, orange), and VITAMINC (13.0%, light blue). Smaller sources include SCITAIL (1.2%, green), MULTINLI (11.3%, red), and PUBHEALTH (0.5%, dark green). The smallest contributions are from SCIFACT (0.1%, dark blue), ENTFA (1.8%, yellow), FACTCC (2.6%, dark green), and ANLI (4.6%, dark orange). Each slice is labeled with its source name and percentage, and lines connect the labels to their respective segments, with some labels positioned outside the chart. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, generally in descending order of size from the largest slice.
